I had a great visit to @NIH yesterday with @NewDemCoalition colleagues to get a firsthand look at their cutting-edge research initiatives.

From childhood cancer to substance use and mental health, we'll continue working in a bipartisan way to support lifesaving medical research. https://t.co/AJjdlQUhTS

We've put money back in the pockets of families by lowering health care premiums.

Making health care more affordable is a top priority for me in Congress, so I'm proud that thanks to this law over 38,000 people in #VA10 are saving an average of $800/year on health care costs. https://t.co/vnP2dBrRMJ
An update on my health and my plans for serving #VA10 in Congress. https://t.co/815hxhtRBv

More than 127,000 moms and young children in Virginia will lose crucial food assistance if extreme Republicans send us into a government shutdown this week.

These reckless political games are putting the health and well-being of our kids at stake.
https://t.co/6JeI71p3nV

Attention #VA10 veterans—don't miss this month's PACT Act deadline.

If you were deployed to a combat zone and left active duty between 9/11/01 and 10/1/13, you're now eligible to enroll in VA health care before September 30th.

Sign up here ⬇️
https://t.co/9UUMb1YZr6

This is big news! When we passed the Inflation Reduction Act, we took on Big Pharma and won by finally empowering Medicare to negotiate drug prices.

Now, thanks to our work in Congress, #VA10 seniors are saving money on their prescription drugs.
https://t.co/9Zlh1OE3Un

Taking care of your mental health is just as important as your physical health. This #WorldMentalHealthDay, I encourage you to take the time to check in with yourself and your loved ones.

In Congress, I'm working to expand mental health resources, especially in our schools. https://t.co/wR3BHM1UGB

I’m horrified and heartbroken at this strike at a hospital in Gaza caring for the many wounded and their families.

Innocent civilians must be protected and aid be allowed to reach those suffering in Gaza.
https://t.co/3g8cGln7ku

I'm encouraged to see news of aid arriving to support Palestinian families in Gaza over the weekend.

I support @POTUS making it a priority that innocent civilians can receive essential food, water, and medical care.
https://t.co/norX2IFq3y

I applaud @POTUS for taking action to keep Americans healthy & safe from exposure to the toxic chemical TCE.

TCE is linked to serious health conditions like cancer & neurological diseases like Parkinson's. This would be a big step to protect public health.https://t.co/uW94mWsVt8

There is a growing humanitarian crisis in Gaza, and children and families need food, water, and medical aid.

As the fight against the terrorist group Hamas continues, innocent lives must be protected and cared for at every turn.

Today I'm sending a letter in support of @EPA's new proposed rule to protect Americans from the health and environmental dangers of TCE.

This dangerous chemical has been linked to a variety of conditions, including Parkinson's—and it's time to take action. https://t.co/HoYeKfSCxA

Big news for Virginians with diabetes to start the new year!

Thanks to our work to lower drug prices through the #InflationReductionAct, another insulin company is dropping its prices.

More Americans are saving money on their lifesaving prescriptions.
https://t.co/fZ8JifFe7N

Attention #VA10—you have ONE more week to find the right health insurance plan for you and your family before the open enrollment deadline!

Explore your affordable coverage options through Virginia’s Insurance Marketplace by clicking the link below ⬇️
https://t.co/FBDaPFoAWL

Big milestone today—20 million Americans now have affordable health care thanks to the Affordable Care Act.

The ACA has been a lifechanging law for families across the country. That’s why I'm fighting to build on it to bring down costs and expand access—not tear it apart.

Boosting mental health support for our kids has been a priority for me in Congress.

I'm proud that today @VP announced $285 million to hire & train school counselors as a part of the largest investment ever in student mental health thanks to our bipartisan Safer Communities Act.

51 years ago today, Roe v. Wade guaranteed a woman’s freedom to choose as a protected right all across the country.

Since it was overturned, women’s health and women’s rights have been under attack.

I’m proud to be fighting back in Congress to enshrine abortion rights into law.

The efforts to restrict access to IVF is an attack on women’s health and the freedom of families to plan for their future.

This is another dangerous direct result of the backwards and wrongful decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, and we must fight back.
https://t.co/PYKRujGXwq

💟 $4,116,279 for the Loudoun County Crisis Receiving Center to support the design and construction of a new center that will help better treat and provide services for those experiencing a mental health crisis in our community. https://t.co/nsEhslaym6

🌊 $1,334,757 for Transite Drinking Water and Sewer Line Replacement in Lovettsville to address known potential public health issues in drinking water and wastewater lines and help improve public health and safety. https://t.co/GWfIOAwi8B

Extreme Republicans are waging attacks on women's reproductive rights in Congress & in states across the country.

I'm proud to stand with @POTUS against these efforts to strip away fundamental freedoms and pass the Women's Health Protection Act to defend abortion access.

#SOTU

PSA: Veterans exposed to toxins while serving are now eligible to enroll directly in VA health care without first applying for benefits.

This expansion of VA health care access will help more veterans get the care they need and deserve.

Learn more ➡️ https://t.co/LSOIDPNG0W

I’m proud to successfully deliver nearly $8 million for local projects throughout Loudoun.

This federal funding will help reduce traffic congestion, expand resources for domestic violence survivors, improve mental health care in the region, and more.
https://t.co/DbykHBcDrt

Thank you to the health care experts & providers who joined my roundtable w/@MarkWarner & @ChairRandall yesterday.

I enjoyed the productive discussion about mental health needs and how the new crisis receiving center I secured federal funding for will make an impact in Loudoun. https://t.co/Ul95CRR3S7

This new center will expand care capacity and improve the crisis response process to help #VA10 residents facing mental health challenges receive the support and treatment they need.

I’m proud to have successfully delivered more than $4 million to make this project possible.
